title: Deepcask outage takes down apps and websites

facts.f01: A Deepcask storage outage broke apps and websites
facts.f03: Caused by a cooling failure at its Ohio data center
facts.f04: 1,800 storage servers were shut down to protect drives

ohm-and-bit.title: Deepcask outage takes down apps and websites
ohm-and-bit.author: Rafe Okonkwo-Hart
body: [f01: A Deepcask storage outage broke apps and websites on Friday morning, leaving images missing and uploads stuck.] [f02: The outage lasted 2 hours and 10 minutes.]

[f03: The cause was physical rather than digital: a cooling failure at Deepcask's Ohio data center.] Hard drives wear out faster when they run hot, so a warm room quickly becomes a risk to the data on them. [f04: To protect the drives, Deepcask shut down 1,800 storage servers.]
[f05: Deepcask says no customer data was lost.] Two hours without access is painful for the apps that depend on it, but losing files would have been far worse.

byteward.title: Deepcask storage outage knocks apps and websites offline
byteward.author: Dana Whitlock
body: [f01: An outage at cloud storage provider Deepcask left apps and websites unable to load files for part of Friday morning.] [f03: The company blamed a cooling failure at its data center in Ohio.]
[f06: The photo app Shutterkin and the design tool Layloft were among the services that couldn't open files.] [f07: Deepcask says it will publish a full incident report within 14 days.]
Until then, customers will have to take the company's word that the fix will hold.

wirefold.title: Deepcask outage leaves apps and websites unable to load files
body: Cloud storage provider Deepcask said Friday it was working to restore service after an outage left apps and websites unable to load files.
